hero.name: Jonah Doe PhD
hero.role: Department of History, Greenhill University, CA
hero.intro: I study how communities remember - and how archives decide what gets remembered. My work moves between the reading room and the classroom, and I write for anyone who has ever wondered why the past looks the way it does.

publications.heading: Publications
publications.body: Two decades of peer-reviewed articles, chapters and monographs on nineteenth-century social history. Every entry links out to the publisher or an open-access copy where one exists.
publications.imageAlt: A stack of academic books on a desk
